tagline: Designer, manufacturer and marketer of systems and equipment for moving, measuring, mixing, controlling, dispensing and spraying fluid and powder materials
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified, revenue is therefore selected as the Hero KPI to reflect organic and acquisition-driven growth.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated revenue of the company
kpis.description: Graco Inc.'s revenue increased by 6% in 2025 compared to 2024, rising from $2,113.3M to $2,236.6M, driven by acquisitions in the Contractor and Industrial segments despite ongoing weakness in residential and non-residential construction
kpis.signal: Revenue growth of 6% ($123.3M increase) in 2025 versus 2024, driven by acquisitions and organic growth in EMEA and Asia Pacific

kpis.name: Consolidated gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin as a percentage of the company's consolidated revenue
kpis.description: Graco Inc.'s gross margin was 52.5% in 2025, down 0.6 points from 2024 (53.1%), as pricing realization did not fully offset rising product costs including tariffs and the dilutive effect of acquisitions
kpis.signal: Gross margin declined by 0.6 percentage points, impacted by $14M in tariff-related costs and lower margins from acquired operations

kpis.name: Product development investments
kpis.explanation: Expenditures on the development of new products and technologies
kpis.description: Graco invested $82M in product development in 2025, representing approximately 4% of revenue, increasing to develop new offerings across each operating segment and support long-term growth objectives
kpis.signal: Product development investments held at $82M (approximately 4% of revenue) in 2025, up 6% to support strategic growth

kpis.name: Revenue 2025
kpis.description: Graco Inc.'s revenue increased by 6% in 2025 compared to 2024, reaching $2,236.6M, driven by acquisitions contributing $123M (5 percentage points) and organic growth in EMEA (2%) and Asia Pacific (1%)
kpis.signal: Revenue growth of 6% in 2025 driven by acquisitions and recovery in certain key end markets

risks.title: Economic and demand risk
risks.score_rationale: Demand for Graco's products depends on the level of global commercial and industrial activity. Economic slowdowns, recessions, persistent inflationary pressures, or financial market turbulence could significantly reduce demand

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: A significant number of routine transactions are conducted in foreign currencies. Fluctuations and volatility in exchange rates have impacted and will continue to impact revenue and earnings

risks.title: Supply chain and cost risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to supply chain disruption risks and rising production costs, including tariffs directly impacting gross margins

risks.title: Geopolitical risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally and is exposed to geopolitical risks including international conflicts and tensions affecting its supply chains and markets

risks.title: Market and construction risk
risks.score_rationale: Persistent weakness in residential and non-residential construction markets directly affects the Contractor segment, which represents 48% of revenue

risks.title: Intellectual property risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in technology-driven areas requiring intellectual property protection, exposed to risks of infringement and counterfeiting

risks.title: Acquisition integration risk
risks.score_rationale: Graco executes strategic acquisitions ($123M contribution in 2025) with risks related to integration and realization of expected synergies

ai_positioning.summary: The company GGG has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K filing.
